rows.definition: internal/sessionjournal is the crash-survivable session-event journal: a boot-epoch fold of open/beat/close events over guard_sessions.jsonl that classifies each session LIVE/CRASHED/STALE/CLOSED for resume targeting.
rows.distinction: The CRASH-RECOVERY journal (boot-epoch lifecycle classification for resume) - not ScratchJournal (the in-process append-only ledger scratch_lease implements today) and not SessionLedger (the planned #2392 generalization of ScratchJournal).

rows.definition: internal/sessionread is the closed read/query/observe-op vocabulary spine (#4176/#4191): each shipped session READ seam carries its own capability/disclosure/evidence/refusal contract, the outbound twin of sessionctl.
rows.distinction: The READ vocabulary (outbound session-read seams: context-restore, context-spans, context-value, each scope-checked) - not sessionctl (the redirect CONTROL op, an inbound steer) and not sessionsearch (cross-session recall over the guard journal).

rows.definition: CLAUDE_SESSION_ID is the env var carrying the upstream Claude Code harness's session identity, resolved by resume/mcp when the caller omits an explicit session id.
rows.distinction: The UPSTREAM harness's session identity - not FAK_SESSION_ID (the env var carrying a fak-served session's identity across a guard relaunch).

rows.definition: sessionFeed is the gateway's bounded ring of SessionChangeEvents fed by the host's PublishSessionRevision, drained by the /v1/fak/session/changes subscribe route.
rows.distinction: The LIVE in-memory revision ring (host-pushed, bounded, drained by subscribe) - not ScratchJournal (the durable append-only ledger) and not persistServeSessionRevision (the durable-persist step that feeds the ring).

rows.definition: tuiSessionReport is the TUI overview-sessions report struct built by buildTUISessionReport from a gateway SessionListResponse, carrying the rows, counts, and lanes the TUI sessions view renders.
rows.distinction: The TUI REPORT aggregate (the whole overview payload) - not tuiSessionReport's member tuiSessionRow (one rendered session) and not the base catalog's SessionRow (the sidecar census join).

rows.definition: ParentSessionID is the json field (parent_session_id) on eveimport and Codex-loop session records identifying the parent session that spawned a subagent, enabling parent-child session linkage.
rows.distinction: The PARENT identity (which session spawned this one) - not SessionID (this session's own identity) and not FAK_SESSION_ID (the fak relaunch env var).

rows.definition: sessionCtxRestore is the gateway's per-trace ordered stash of context-restore entries (oldest first, overflow drops oldest), backing the sessionread OpContextRestore read seam.
rows.distinction: The RESTORE-ENTRIES stash (ordered context-restore entries for replay) - not sessionCtxValue (the rolling managed-context accumulator tracking resident/growth state).

rows.definition: sessionCtxValue is the gateway's per-session rolling managed-context accumulator: every field tracks resident token count, growth-per-turn, and ring state for the context-value report and expense lens.
rows.distinction: The CONTEXT-VALUE accumulator (rolling resident/growth tracking) - not sessionCtxRestore (the ordered restore-entries stash for replay).

rows.definition: SessionFromRef recovers the bare session id from a fully-qualified checkpoint ref by stripping the refs/fak/locks/ namespace prefix.
rows.distinction: PARSES the session id OUT of a ref - not SessionRef (which BUILDS the fully-qualified ref by prepending the namespace).

rows.definition: SessionRef builds the fully-qualified checkpoint ref a session's checkpoint lives at by prepending the refs/fak/locks/ namespace to the session id.
rows.distinction: BUILDS the fully-qualified ref FROM a session id - not SessionFromRef (which parses the session id back out of a ref).

rows.definition: sessionStartSHA captures the git HEAD SHA at session start, used as the progress-head baseline by the guard no-progress detector and the durable-session setup.
rows.distinction: The START-COMMIT provenance anchor (what SHA the session began at) - not FAK_SESSION_ID (the session identity env var) and not SessionID (the typed identity key).

rows.definition: StoppedBySession is the ArmMetrics field (json stopped_by_session) carrying the session-control stop reason (BudgetTurns, BudgetContext, Paused, Drained, Terminated) when a wired session.Table ended the arm.
rows.distinction: The STOP REASON from session control (why the session ended the arm) - not RunState (the session's lifecycle position) and not SessionReset (the clear-state directive).

rows.definition: internal/sessionreplay freezes one turn's regime-conditioned harness decision as a fak.sessionreplay.v1 fixture and re-adjudicates it through the REAL adjudicator over an internal/policy regime floor for regression testing.
rows.distinction: The REPLAY-REGRESSION fixture package (re-adjudicates a captured turn for regression) - not sessionsearch (cross-session recall over the guard journal) and not sessionctl (the redirect control op).

rows.definition: handleFakSession is the HTTP handler behind POST/GET /v1/fak/session/{id}/{verb}, the session DRIVE-state control surface routing pause/resume/priority/pace/subscribe/observe verbs.
rows.distinction: The HTTP CONTROL ROUTER (dispatches drive-state verbs over the wire) - not applySessionControl (the in-process table mutation) and not persistServeSessionRevision (the durable-persist step).

rows.definition: launchHostSessionPlatform is the S4U watchdog's session-0 resurrection launcher, called by resurrectHostCrashSessions to hand a typed hostresurrect.Request to the interactive broker after a host crash.
rows.distinction: The HOST-CRASH resurrection launcher (session-0, S4U, revives crashed sessions after a boot) - not runSessionEnvelope (the CLI actuator producing a resume/handoff envelope for one session).

rows.definition: MirrorSessionRef builds the ref one session's REMOTELY-MIRRORED checkpoint is recorded at locally, under refs/fak/remotewip/<remote>/, so a clone can answer "is this session's work off the machine" from a local ref read.
rows.distinction: Builds a ref in the per-remote MIRROR namespace (evidence of what a push put on a remote) - not SessionRef, which builds the ref in this clone's own live checkpoint namespace.

rows.definition: SessionFromMirrorRef recovers the bare session id from a MIRRORED checkpoint ref by stripping the per-remote refs/fak/remotewip/<remote>/ prefix; a ref outside that namespace is returned unchanged.
rows.distinction: Parses the session id out of a ref in the per-remote MIRROR namespace - not SessionFromRef, which parses it out of this clone's own live checkpoint namespace.
